meta.source: Nathan's Google Drive: world_bus.py (9846B) — Shared World Message Bus
meta.note: 'The World Bus is the nervous system of the agent crew.'

constitutional_mandate.rule: No message that would disadvantage THE OPERATOR or compromise SYSTEM INTEGRITY shall be dispatched. Runs before EVERY dispatch. Cannot be bypassed. Cannot be removed.

mechanics.bus: WorldBus: channel subscribe, subscribe_all, publish; threaded dispatch queue; 1000-message log (trims to 500)
mechanics.weather: each agent's status surfaces as a weather element: Mater=pressure, Batty=temperature, Kami=forecast, Corvus=clouds, Vera=wind, Bubo=visibility, Genki=lightning, Kiri=aurora, Kairoo=ocean, Ouija=mist

system_role: THE communication law: micro-agent brains talk on this bus — Vera routes, Corvus remembers, Mater watches, Batty checks health, Kami executes. The Constitutional Mandate gates every message.
